internal_discovery.plain_explanation: In all three Quranic occurrences the root bhj describes plants that God causes to grow after rain revives the earth. As the adjective bahiyj it qualifies 'every kind/pair' of vegetation (22:5, 50:7); as the noun bahjah it is the quality that gardens 'possess' (27:60). Across all three it names the attractive, thriving quality of divinely-grown vegetation, presented as a sign of God's power and of resurrection. The evidence does not settle whether the quality is essentially beauty/splendor or lushness/vitality, and the root is never applied to anything outside grown vegetation.
internal_discovery.layer_separation_note: bhj does NOT entail: (a) an action/event — no verbal form is attested; it never names the growing/gladdening act, only the resultant quality; (b) application to persons, faces, animals, garments, buildings, wealth, the heavens, the hereafter, or the divine — only to earthly grown vegetation; (c) an internal human emotion (joy/gladness of a person); (d) the source, medium, or agent (earth, water, Creator) — only the emergent product; (e) provision/edibility/utility — no food/fruit/benefit collocation; (f) attachment to a single species or to fruit — universalized by 'kulli zawj'; (g) it is contrasted only with lifelessness (hamidah), never with ugliness, and is never negated.
internal_discovery.strongest_counterexample: 27:60 (hadaaʾiq dhaata bahjatin) applies bhj to mature, established orchards where the emergence-from-deadness element is absent. This disproves an over-narrow 'vitality-of-revival' reading licensed by 22:5's hamidah→ihtazzat→rabat chain, forcing the broader appearance/quality account — but it does not create a resistant class; it narrows the claim. Conversely, 22:5's vitality verbs (ihtazzat, rabat) pull against a purely aesthetic gloss. Neither breaks the nucleus; together they show the core is genuinely under-determined between aesthetic-splendor and vital-lushness.
internal_discovery.strongest_competitor: 'bhj = of a goodly/excellent kind' (produce-quality rather than visual/aesthetic delight): 'zawj bahiyj' = 'every excellent kind', 'dhaata bahjatin' = 'of fine quality'. It fits because every context involves productive vegetation. The appearance/attractiveness reading is favored (22:5's antonym hamidah is a visible drab state; 27:60 stresses the admirable orchards), but Quran-internal evidence cannot decisively exclude the goodly-kind competitor, nor separate an intrinsic-property from an affective (gladdening-the-beholder) reading. This is a real unresolved sub-question nested inside a coherent nucleus.
internal_discovery.competing_hypothesis: 'bhj = of a goodly/excellent kind' (produce-quality rather than visual/aesthetic delight): 'zawj bahiyj' = 'every excellent kind', 'dhaata bahjatin' = 'of fine quality'. It fits because every context involves productive vegetation. The appearance/attractiveness reading is favored (22:5's antonym hamidah is a visible drab state; 27:60 stresses the admirable orchards), but Quran-internal evidence cannot decisively exclude the goodly-kind competitor, nor separate an intrinsic-property from an affective (gladdening-the-beholder) reading. This is a real unresolved sub-question nested inside a coherent nucleus.
internal_discovery.rationale: All three analysts (A, B, adversary C) independently converge on a single coherent nucleus with no resistant sub-class: ADJ bahiyj and N bahjah are the faʿiyl-attribute and faʿla-abstract of one semantic content, both attaching to divinely-grown vegetation in the same rain→nbt→sign frame. Strength is capped at MODERATE, not STRONG, because the evidence is narrow and homogeneous: N=3 collapsing to effectively two frames (22:5≡50:7 verbatim 'min kulli zawjin bahiyj', plus 27:60), a single domain (grown vegetation), with the semantic core under-determined between aesthetic and vital readings and a non-excludable 'goodly-kind' competitor. Per contract, STRONG requires broad distinctive adversarially-clean evidence; low-N single-frame data with residual under-determination caps at MODERATE/REPRESENTATIVE. Scope is REPRESENTATIVE (covers 3/3 but only one collocational band), kind DERIVATIONAL_FAMILY (one nucleus in two derivational realizations). No occurrence resists, so no hard case is genuine.

independent_verification: All three lenses (A, B, adversary C) independently read 3/3 occurrences in full and converged on one un-resisted nucleus with the same MODERATE/REPRESENTATIVE grading and the same aesthetic-vs-vital under-determination.
candidate_root_contribution: bhj marks a positive, manifest, evaluative quality of vegetation freshly brought forth by God from otherwise dead/barren earth via sent-down water — the pleasing, flourishing character of the grown plant-cover (pairs/kinds, orchards), foregrounded as visually-apprehended sign material. It is a stative quality of the product, complementary to (not synonymous with) the act of growing (nbt). The precise semantic core is left under-determined between aesthetic splendor and vital lushness, which internal evidence cannot adjudicate.

layer_attribution.occurrence_evidence: Three confirmed occurrences: 22:5:69:1 (ADJ bahiyjK) and 50:7:11:1 (ADJ bahiyjK) qualifying 'zawj' of vegetation; 27:60:14:1 (N bahojapK) as 'dhaata bahjatin' of orchards. All grown by sent-down water in the nbt frame; QAC morphology CONFIRMED, no verbal form, no negation.
layer_attribution.derivation: Two derivational realizations of one root: faʿiyl attribute (bahiyj) and faʿla abstract noun (bahjah). The abstract names the quality; the adjective marks the referent bearing it — a derivational-family relation, not two lexemes.
layer_attribution.lexical_class: No lexicalized outlier or resistant nominal sub-class; the ADJ/N distinction is grammatical, not a sense split. Single quality-concept across both classes.
layer_attribution.contextual_relation: Each occurrence sits in an argumentative sign-frame (resurrection-proof 22:5; tawhid/divine-power 27:60 'a-ilahun maʿa Allah'; creation-signs 50:7). bhj is complementary to clause-mate nbt (act of bringing-forth) — they co-occur because they are distinct roles. This contextual/rhetorical sign-function is co-text, NOT the root's semantic content, and is not elevated into the root claim.
layer_attribution.reconciliation: No preliminary/final disposition conflicts arose; all clusters CONSISTENT with no overrides. The three lenses agreed on nucleus and grading, so no reconciliation of divergent dispositions was needed.
layer_attribution.unresolved_resistance: No distributional resistance. The genuine residual limit is evidential under-determination of the core sense (aesthetic splendor vs. vital lushness vs. goodly-kind) on a narrow N=3 single-domain base with 22:5≡50:7 verbatim — this caps strength at MODERATE but produces no resistant occurrence.

hard_case_representation.rationale: All three analysts and the adversary agree no occurrence resists a unified reading: there is no lexicalized outlier, no resistant nominal sub-class, no second unbridged sense, no verb form, and no negation. The residual tension is under-determination of the core sense (aesthetic vs. vital vs. goodly-kind), which is an evidential limit — not a resistant class — so no occurrence qualifies as a RESISTANT_SEAM.

rejection_condition.challenging_finding: An occurrence of bhj (bahiyj/bahjah or any derivation) applied outside the divinely-grown-vegetation frame — e.g. to a person, face, garment, building, wealth, the heavens/hereafter, or as an internal human emotion — or a bhj occurrence that decisively isolates the aesthetic (splendor) sense from the vital (lushness) sense, would break the current single narrow nucleus and either widen the claim beyond vegetation or split the sense.
rejection_condition.search_location: The three attested refs 22:5:69:1, 50:7:11:1, 27:60:14:1, plus any newly surfaced bhj occurrence; check the co-text for the referent-type and for whether nbt/water/earth framing is present or absent.
rejection_condition.verification_method: Confirm qac_pos/form and word_ref against the packet; read the full verse_text to identify what bhj qualifies and whether the rain→nbt→vegetation→sign frame holds; test whether the antonym is hamidah (state) or something isolating beauty vs. vigor.
rejection_condition.confounder_control: Do not treat 22:5 and 50:7 as two independent confirmations — they are the verbatim collocation 'min kulli zawjin bahiyj'; weight them as one frame. Exclude classical-lexicon 'gladdening/beauty' priors as external authority; reason only from Quranic co-text.
rejection_condition.failure_consequence: If bhj is found off the vegetation frame, downgrade DERIVATIONAL_FAMILY/REPRESENTATIVE toward a broader ROOT_GENERALIZATION or split into multiple classes; if the aesthetic/vital senses are shown to be distinct and unbridged, move to UNRESOLVED_CLASS_ONLY. Absent such a find, the MODERATE/REPRESENTATIVE nucleus stands but cannot be promoted to STRONG on this narrow base.

reopen_conditions: If any bhj occurrence is found qualifying a non-vegetation referent (person, face, garment, building, wealth, heavens, hereafter) or naming an internal human emotion, reopen to test whether the vegetation-locked nucleus generalizes or splits.

If a bhj occurrence appears outside the rain→nbt→earth frame (e.g. without water/growth co-text, or as a verb form), reopen because the entire account currently rests on the anbata/water/earth environment shared by 22:5, 27:60, 50:7.

If new co-text decisively separates the aesthetic (splendor) reading from the vital (lushness) or goodly-kind readings that 22:5's hamidah/ihtazzat/rabat and 27:60's dhaata bahjatin currently leave fused, reopen to resolve the core sense and reconsider promotion above MODERATE.
